Data Engineer

Company: Rewired Consulting
Employment type: Full time

What This Role Does
- Partner with a leading banking client to deliver data engineering projects across New Zealand and Australia.
- Build scalable data pipelines, curated datasets, and governed semantic layers for reporting and finance use cases.
- Work across requirements, design, build, deployment, and handover in a regulated environment.

Core Requirements
- Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with Snowflake.
- Experience with dbt, including testing, documentation, and deployment.
- Exposure to data modelling, including dimensional modelling or DV2.
- Ability to work through ambiguity and deliver outcomes under deadlines.

Bonus Requirements
- Experience building or supporting semantic layers.
- Familiarity with cloud-based data orchestration tools such as ADF.
- Strong communication skills across technical and business stakeholders.

Qualifications
- Proven experience delivering data engineering solutions in production environments.
- Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with Snowflake.
- Experience with dbt, including testing, documentation, and deployment.
- Exposure to data modelling, including dimensional modelling or DV2.
- Experience building or supporting semantic layers.
- Familiarity with cloud-based data orchestration tools such as ADF.
- Ability to work through ambiguity and deliver outcomes under deadlines.
- Strong communication skills across technical and business stakeholders.

Benefits
- Hybrid work options.
- Professional development budget.

Application Notes
- Apply with your CV and cover letter.
